dossiers.financial_spine: Multi Commodity Exchange — dominant (~99% share) asset-light commodity-derivatives exchange. +138% FY26 PAT (Rs83cr FY24 -> Rs1,332cr FY26) is a triple-tailwind PEAK: FY24-trough recovery (the ~Rs125cr/qtr 63-Moons software gouge is gone) + TCS-to-in-house platform one-time cost step-down + a record bullion super-cycle (bullion ADT +496%) — NOT repeatable. EBITDA margin 71-73% (+~1,050bps YoY), ROCE 71.4%. Genuinely elite; the over-rate is VALUATION at a cyclical peak, not quality.
dossiers.drivers: Options-PREMIUM ADT (the real revenue driver, not headline notional), futures ADT, SEBI-fixed take-rate, new products (electricity derivatives), the lower post-TCS cost base.
dossiers.dependencies: SEBI-mandated FIXED take-rate (Rs2.1/lakh futures, Rs41.8/lakh options-premium) — pricing capped, a future 'true-to-label' cut is pure downside; NSE energy-derivatives competition (launched Feb-2026 into the ~70% of MCX options turnover that is energy); bullion/commodity volatility cycle.
dossiers.forensics: Fortress net cash -Rs4,099cr (borrowings Rs5cr vs cash+investments ~Rs4,104cr); NO promoter / NO pledge / ~99% share. Not an accrual/quality over-rate. Valuation reconciliation: consolidated EPS Rs52.22 (~52.6x) vs standalone Rs40.36 (~68x) — both correct, both expensive vs global peers CME/ICE/DB/CBOE at 19-25x. Headline notional options ADT (Rs4.72 lakh cr) is a vanity metric; revenue scales with PREMIUM ADT (+109%).

valuation.method: cyclically-peaked ~54x consol / ~68x standalone on non-repeatable base-effect earnings; even ICICIdirect HOLD (TP Rs3,380 at 42x FY28E)

dossiers.prediction: 30d in-line to -5% vs Nifty; 60d underperform 0-8% (Q1FY27 print the swing as base-effect exhausts); 90d -4% to -12% base case. Hard-falsifier: FY27 options-premium ADT + PAT growth holds >25-30% WITH bullion vol normalising AND NSE energy share negligible AND no SEBI fee cut.

dossiers.financial_spine: Cummins India (power gen / engines / distribution; 51% parent Cummins Inc). Genuinely excellent, cash-generative, debt-free MNC subsidiary. FY26 ROCE ~40%, EBITDA margin 21.4% (+140bps). OCF/PAT 0.73 (sub-1 only because ~23% of PBT is treasury other income — clean, not an accrual mirage). Management guides only ~10-12% near-term growth; industrial segment flat, exports fell 6% in Q4, and the CPCB-IV+ price lever is spent. The over-rate is VALUATION, not quality.
dossiers.drivers: Power-gen/genset demand (the data-centre narrative), exports, distribution/aftermarket, the (now-spent) CPCB-IV+ emission transition.
dossiers.dependencies: Parent Cummins Inc (royalty/RPT — a standard MNC-subsidiary monitorable, no abuse evidence, ~70% payout); the data-centre capex cycle; export markets.
dossiers.forensics: Fortress net cash -Rs2,100cr (borrowings Rs37cr vs investments Rs2,153cr); FCF Rs1,487cr. Not a quality/governance issue. The over-rate: ~62-66x P/E = ~1.8x its own 10yr-median (~35x) + ~2-3x parent Cummins Inc (~22-35x) + domestic peers (Kirloskar ~35x, Greaves ~27x). The 35x->65x re-rate was multiple expansion on the DC narrative (stock 45% CAGR vs PAT 30%). TELL: sell-side consensus target Rs5,296 is BELOW the price; IDBI SELL Rs5,046; PEG 3.5. Data gap: exact royalty/RPT quantum not primary-readable (403s).

valuation.method: ~45x normalised on ~10-12% guided growth; mean-reversion toward ~45x on flat-to-rising earnings drives the downside

dossiers.prediction: 30d in-line to -6%; 60d underperform 0-10% (Q1FY27 print ~Aug the swing); 90d -5% to -15%. Hard-falsifier: FY27 group revenue re-accelerates >15% WITH EBITDA margin >=21% AND industrial + exports both recover. Downside trigger: any DC-capex pause / export miss / margin slip / multiple mean-reversion -> 15-25% de-rate. Floor ~Rs3,600 (a de-rate of a great business, not a collapse).

dossiers.financial_spine: Great Eastern Shipping (tanker / product / LPG / dry-bulk + Greatship offshore). A cycle-position / peak-earnings name, NOT a quality/leverage/governance problem. Reported FY26 PAT Rs2,943cr (+26%) is really normalised ~Rs2,688cr (+10%) — flattered by profit-on-sale-of-ships Rs441cr + FX gains Rs433cr. EBITDA margin 58% (+790bps YoY) is a freight-rate cycle-up move (TCYs +10-98% YoY), reverses in a downturn (FY22 was 44%).
dossiers.drivers: Tanker/product/gas freight rates (TCYs); offshore (Greatship) day-rates; fleet size/age; opportunistic ship-sale gains.
dossiers.dependencies: Freight-rate cycle (crude TCYs coming off the Hormuz war-spike; only 52-66% coverage locked); secondhand vessel-value cycle (the NAV cushion); the record 2026 orderbook (crude 22% / product 19% / VLGC 28% of fleet) delivering into CY27/CY28 = future supply.
dossiers.forensics: Fortress net cash -Rs7,402cr (USD ~516mn; AAA; cash ~36% of mkt cap). NAV cushion is PEAK-ASSET-MARKED — the 0.75x-consol-NAV 'cheapness' rests on secondhand vessel values at/near historic highs (asset indices 173-211 vs base 100); a 15-20% vessel-value correction wipes the entire NAV discount. Trailing P/E 6.5x is the bait; mid-cycle P/E is 2-3x that. Entry near the FY26 peak (~Rs1,500-1,800) was a mild value-trap error; at Rs1,345 risk/reward has re-set to fair-to-modestly-cheap.

valuation.method: P/NAV 0.7-0.9x consol NAV Rs1,796 + mid-cycle earnings x8-9 + net cash; sell-side Rs1,552-2,050 extrapolates peak earnings

dossiers.prediction: 30d in-line to -2 pts; 60d Q1FY27 (~mid-Aug) is the pivot — crude/product TCYs come off the war-spike -> QoQ earnings decline off the Rs1,044cr Q4 peak -> flat-to-underperform; 90d holds Rs1,250-1,450, ~2-4 pts underperformance. Break below Rs1,250 (0.7x NAV) = ADD trigger. Hard bear-falsifier: freight rates + vessel values HOLD through 2H-CY26 despite the record orderbook AND offshore reprices up -> re-rate to Rs1,700-1,865.
